title: Witch on Bug Bridge
description: A witch in a flowing green robe and pointed hat stands on a red arched bridge, holding a staff topped with a glowing beetle. The dark scene features constellations, a large beetle in the sky, rocky terrain below with many smaller beetles, lit candles, and colorful bokeh orbs under the bridge.
prompt: A witch wearing a flowing green robe and pointed hat stands on a red Japanese-style arched bridge at night, holding a wooden staff topped with a large glowing beetle. A giant beetle and star constellations appear in the dark sky above. Below the bridge are dark rocky formations covered with many smaller beetles and lit candles, with colorful glowing bokeh orbs floating underneath.
